scope: Spreadsheet formula prefixes in stored or exported fields that execute when opened in a spreadsheet.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: the field value and sink_context. Keep a value starting with =, +, - or @ in a field that is exported to CSV; make it ordinary data that legitimately starts that way (international phone number, signed amount, @mention, math note) with no spreadsheet function, DDE or external reference. Do not make it benign by escaping a real formula.
